title: Speculative Abstraction over Multiple Databases
pattern: Defining database-agnostic interfaces when the application only has a single SQL database engine and will never change it.
why_bad: Prevents utilizing engine-specific optimizations and adds massive interface boilerplate.
detection: Database-agnostic traits with exactly one implementer.
fix: Use the concrete database driver client directly.
source: Vaughn Vernon, *Implementing Domain-Driven Design* (2013); Juval Löwy, *Righting Software* (2019).
